assessment: In this manuscript, Falo-Sanjuan and Bray provide an elegant set of experiments investigating how cell movements modulate Notch transcriptional activity during Drosophila gastrulation. Through a detailed and convincing analysis of live transcriptional reporters and gastrulation-defective mutants, they report a clear example of tissue movements affecting enhancer activity. The idea that morphogenetic movements can regulate the genome through mechanical changes in the nucleus is intriguing and important and is of broad interest to cell and developmental biologists.
